name: San Roque (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over red in the proportions 2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Roque (a castle on red above a dog).
history: Municipal flag of San Roque; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: San Roque arms — castle above a dog
